title: Linear algebra for ML
summary: Vectors and matrices as the working language of ML: geometry and projections, matrices as maps, least squares solved stably, eigenvalues as dynamics, the SVD and low-rank structure, PCA and POD of a temperature field, and the matrix calculus that Module 3 builds on.
objectives: Read vectors and matrices geometrically: dot products, projections, matrices as maps of space, rank, column and null spaces
Solve linear systems and least-squares problems stably (solve and QR, never an explicit inverse) and predict the accuracy you'll get from the condition number
Use eigendecomposition to analyse linear dynamics, thermal time constants and quadratic forms
Compute and interpret the SVD: low-rank approximation, numerical rank and the pseudoinverse
Apply PCA and POD to a sensor field: center it, choose the number of modes from the energy captured, and reconstruct missing readings
Derive gradients of linear and quadratic forms and verify them with finite differences

build.title: Sensor field reconstruction
build.summary: POD of the data hall's rack-inlet temperature field, used to reconstruct three failed sensors from the rest, with a held-out evaluation and an honest error budget.
